verdict.rationale: Riveter does web scraping and extraction, so an undetected or stealth browser mode for getting past bot detection is a fair question for it. None of the evidence mentions stealth browsing, fingerprint evasion, or bypassing anti-bot systems. The scrape and 'complicated websites' extraction claims describe parsing pages, not evading detection.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an undetected browser mode to bypass sophisticated bot detection systems
